findings.title: Positional sibling failures from nested clean checkout (unchanged class)
findings.detail: From .review-zr804-805-clean, test_t3_suite_is_opt_in_and_covers_three_markets and test_unauthorized_missing_source_zero_downloads_in_journal fail for the same positional reason documented in prior ZRR805-REV-003 (PROJECT_ROOT.parent/'filing-fetch' does not exist under the nested checkout; real sibling is Projects/filing-fetch); 1 passed. Single-file rerun from MAIN repo dir: 3 passed in 1.81s. Purely positional; matches prior accepted review behavior exactly - no regression introduced by the delta.

findings.title: REV-001 fix verified materially non-vacuous; delta scope exact
findings.detail: git diff 3fc5f3e 295f138 touches exactly one file with 1 insertion/1 deletion: line 142 drops '/catalog.sqlite3'. Both call sites of _journal_downloaded_new (lines 92 'before' seed read and line 142 post-run assert) now pass the DIRECTORY project/'.source_catalog'. Independent tamper probe outside both repos: IsolatedLake built from the worktree, fake {'outcome':'downloaded_new'} appended to .source_catalog/acquisition_attempts.jsonl, oracle imported from the worktree tests module -> directory wiring counts 1 (before=0, after=1) while the old file-path argument shape returns constant 0 on identical evidence - proving the pre-fix assertion was vacuous and the fixed wiring genuinely reads acquisition_attempts.jsonl. Prior accepted 12_reviewer_receipt.json canonical fc646953... recomputes exactly (delta anchor intact).

objective: Delta re-review of already-accepted ZR-805 (prior reviewer receipt canonical fc6469538e2980b3e7c7d957cf9c01c2250877245f74481b30de15f647a6861d): verify ONLY the one-line REV-001 follow-up in commit 295f138 - exact diff scope, directory argument at both oracle call sites, suite green, and a non-vacuousness tamper probe proving the fixed assertion actually reads the acquisition journal; no re-litigation of the original acceptance.
